title: WCUQ Visual Tracker Status Schema v2
invariants: Numeric live score may be displayed only when status_state is live_score and created_at_utc is fresh for the active turn policy.
Historical calibration must be stored under last_known_calibration, never as display_text for a live tracker unless explicitly marked stale/unavailable.
When status_state is stale_or_unavailable, display_text must suppress numeric scores.
A v1 text-only status file is legacy evidence and must not be rendered as a live numeric score by the Visual Tracker.
